subject: CS243
filterSummary: Selected 5 English and 4 Arabic videos covering key probability topics. One Arabic topic, 'Variance and Chebyshev's Inequality', had no candidates that covered the full scope of the topic, resulting in an empty selection.

coverage.note: No candidates found that cover Chebyshev's Inequality in Arabic. All found videos only discuss variance, failing the relevance gate.

videos.title: Bayes' Theorem - The Simplest Case
videos.filter_reason: A foundational, highly-viewed explanation of the core concept, perfect for students struggling to apply the formula.

videos.title: Chebyshev's Theorem
videos.filter_reason: This comprehensive tutorial clearly explains the theorem and provides practical examples, addressing the abstract nature of the topic.

videos.title: Lecture 9: Expectation, Indicator Random Variables, Linearity | Statistics 110
videos.filter_reason: A classic Harvard lecture that provides a deep, university-level explanation of linearity and the use of indicator variables.

videos.title: Multiplication & Addition Rule - Probability - Mutually Exclusive & Independent Events
videos.filter_reason: This video directly addresses the common student confusion between mutually exclusive and independent events, with massive view counts confirming its effectiveness.

videos.title: Finding The Probability of a Binomial Distribution Plus Mean & Standard Deviation
videos.filter_reason: An excellent, highly popular video that works through multiple examples, which is crucial for mastering 'exactly', 'at least', and 'at most' calculations.
